description: This Java class manages serial port connections, including opening, configuring, and closing serial ports, and handling data transfer via a binary protocol.

classes.name: PortHolder
classes.description: Singleton class managing serial port connection, configuration, and data communication via a binary protocol, supporting thread-safe operations and event handling.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Public method to open and initialize the serial port, setup data and connection listeners.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Private method that creates and opens the serial port, configures it, and establishes binary protocol communication.

methods.name: setupPort
methods.description: Static method to set serial port parameters and flow control mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serial port connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: packAndSend
methods.description: Sends a command string through the binary protocol, blocking until the connection is available.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PortHolder.
